```yaml
name: Claude Review

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  claude-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .

      - name: Run script with CLI args
        run: |
          python scripts/evaluation_with_nemo_run.py \
            --slurm \
            --account test_account \
            --partition test_partition \
            --job_dir /tmp/job_dir \
            --custom_mounts /tmp/mount

      - name: Run script with env var fallback
        env:
          ACCOUNT: test_account
          PARTITION: test_partition
          CUSTOM_MOUNTS: /tmp/mount
          NEMORUN_HOME: /tmp/job_dir
        run: |
          python scripts/evaluation_with_nemo_run.py --slurm
```
